# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplemental assessment documents generated during architecture and modernization analysis.

## Available Documents

- [`architecture-diagram.md`](./architecture-diagram.md) — Application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [`dependency-map.md`](./dependency-map.md) — External dependency categories, risks, and test dependency inventory.
- [`api-service-contracts.md`](./api-service-contracts.md) — Service catalog, endpoint inventory, communication patterns, and sequence flow.
- [`data-architecture.md`](./data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, entity model ER diagram, and data ownership boundaries.
- [`configuration-inventory.md`](./configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, profiles, properties, secrets workflow, and runtime versions.
- [`business-workflows.md`](./business-workflows.md) — Core business workflows, rules, and business sequence diagram.
